column1: # every library it bundles (#276). Read 2026-11-20: extracted read-only (unsquashfs, never run); each library matched
# by its GNU build-id to the Ubuntu 24.04 (noble, arm64) package it came from (linuxdeploy rewrites RPATH, so the
# bytes differ from the .deb; the build-id does not); SDL2 is ES-DE's own build of SDL release-2.32.10. The licence
# is the library's own, read from the package's copyright file, which the AppImage carries at
# usr/share/doc/<package>/copyright. owes: source = GPL/LGPL/MPL/CDDL (the written offer, the sources asset);
# notice = the copyright file is enough. sha256: the file in the AppImage (licences.py build checks it).
# Not legal advice; I'm not a lawyer.
